paper.title_en: Evolution of collectivity near <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow></math>: Lifetime and electromagnetic transition strengths of the first excited <math><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo></msup></mrow></math> state in <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Ga</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>69</mn></mmultiscripts></math> from <math><mrow><mi>γ</mi><mtext>-</mtext><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> fast-timing measurements
paper.abstract_en: The low-spin structure of the odd-proton nucleus <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Ga</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>69</mn></mmultiscripts></math> (<math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>38</mn></mrow></math>) near <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow></math> has been investigated through a combination of experimental and theoretical approaches. The lifetime of the first excited state <math><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo></msup></mrow></math> has been measured for the first time using the <math><mrow><mi>γ</mi><mtext>-</mtext><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> fast-timing technique with picosecond resolution, yielding a mean lifetime of <math><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>106</mn><mo>(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> ps, equivalent to a half-life of <math><mrow><msub><mi>t</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>73</mn><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ps, from which the reduced transition probabilities <math><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>M</mi><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> and <math><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>E</mi><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> for the <math><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo></msubsup><mo>→</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>/</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo></msup></mrow></math> (ground state) transition have been extracted. Large-scale shell-model calculations employing the GX1APN and JUN45PN effective interactions have been performed for the odd-<math><mi>A</mi></math> Ga isotopes with <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>34</mn></mrow></math> to 40 for comparison. The systematic comparison of transition strengths across the odd-<math><mi>A</mi></math> Ga isotopic chain, supported by large-scale shell-model calculations, is consistent with a gradual structural change from a collectively mixed proton-neutron configuration toward a more single-particle-dominated structure as <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow></math> is approached.
